about_the_game:
Welcome to the heart of the storm. Tornado Hunter throws you into the driver's seat of a high-stakes mission where you are both scientist and adventurer. This isn't just a game; it's a simulation of one of the most dangerous pursuits on Earth.

Your journey begins as a rookie chaser with a beat-up car and a dream. The vast, dynamic open world of Tornado Alley is your playground and your battlefield. Using a combination of instinct, real-time meteorology data, and advanced forecasting tools, you'll analyze unstable atmospheric conditions, pinpoint potential supercell development on your map, and then race against time to intercept.

short_description: Become a Tornado Hunter! Join the thrilling race across the American plains to predict, track, and document the deadliest storms of the century. Risk everything in pursuit of perfect data, but be careful: one wrong move and you'll become a storm victim.
